description: Academic profile, research interests, and contact information for Seyedhamidreza Alaie at New Mexico State University.
body:
Seyedhamidreza Alaie

Assistant Professor

Dr. Alaie is an assistant professor at New Mexico State University. Previously, he was a postdoctoral associate at the medical college of Cornell University, and an adjunct lecturer in the college of technologies of The City University of New York. He obtained his Ph.D. in engineering from the University of New Mexico. He also holds three master’s degrees in computer science, optical science and mechanical engineering. His current research interests are in the areas of phononic crystals, microfabrication of polymeric systems, applications of machine learning in design and fabrication of miniaturized systems, and advanced manufacturing of medical implants. He is awarded an R21 Trailblazer grant by NIH/NIBI for research on development of novel transcatheter medical implants. His research has resulted in over 20 articles published in prestigious journals such as Nature Communications, Nature Biomedical Engineering, Advanced Functional Technologies, and ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces.

title: Laboratory
description: Laboratory layout and equipment for photolithography, silicone processing, nitinol shaping, 3D printing, and computation.
body:
Photolithography

  • Spin coater (shared with soft lithography setup)
  • An in-house LED system for exposure of silicon dies (Thorlabs Mid Power Collimated LED @ 365nm; M365LP1)

Soft Lithography and Silicone Processing

  • Spin coater (shared with photolithography setup)
  • Designated desiccator with Oil Vane Pump (3 Pa) and desiccator for degassing

Nitinol Shape Setting and Catheter Equipment

  • Fabrication of significant fixtures (copper, polymer, and ceramics)
  • Furnace

3D Printing

  • 4 FDM 3D printers with build capabilities up to 450 x 400 x 400mm
  • 4 SLA printers with bed sizes of 8x8 inch

Software

  • ANSYS Mechanical

Computers

  • Laptop Lenovo (Lenovo ThinkPad, Intel Core i7 vPro 7th Gen CPU, 16GB Ram)
  • Laptop HP (HP EliteBook 850 G4, Intel Core i5 vPro 7th Gen CPU)
